headline: Wild place two players on waivers for Nov. 9
take:
Daily Faceoff reports the Wild put Cameron Crotty and Tyler Pitlick on waivers to start the week, likely on the way to the AHL. One caution: our data still has Crotty with Ottawa, where he played three games, so we can't read anything about his time in Minnesota.

Pitlick is a fourth-liner who barely plays: 7.6 minutes a night over 12 games, no points, 32 hits. He's been unlucky in front of the net (no goals on 1.62 expected), and Minnesota held 53% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, so he wasn't hurting them. This is roster housekeeping for a 12-3-4 team that's carrying 56% of the chances. The Wild don't have many problems right now, and this move isn't about one.
